items.note: Rechecked after rewording. en:Central_Park: 'In 1858, landscape architects Frederick Law Olmsted and Calvert Vaux won a design competition for the park with their "Greensward Plan"'; this quote ties the plan to Central Park by name. The 1858 competition and the named Greensward Plan now exclude Morningside and Riverside Parks (Olmsted and Vaux designed Morningside later, by commission). One answer.
